requirements.evidence: Built MediSched with React and TypeScript

suggestions: Move your React projects to the top of the resume.
Add a line about the tests you wrote for MediSched.
coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Junior Web Developer role at Acme Digital. I recently earned a BS in Computer Science and have built and deployed web applications with React, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. In my MediSched project I prevented double bookings with a PostgreSQL exclusion constraint and wrote unit tests for the booking flow. I would welcome the chance to bring this care for correct, tested software to your team.

Sincerely,
Juan Dela Cruz
